policy.retentionDuration: NOT_APPROVED; do not invent TTLs or run bulk purges until RX-DEC-041/RX-DEC-045 are approved.
policy.financialRecords: Do not use ordinary account/test cleanup as a general live payment, ledger, refund or settlement deletion mechanism. Financial retention and anonymization need explicit approval.
policy.privateObjects: Delete private object before deleting its authoritative DB pointer where the user initiated deletion; if object deletion fails, retain the DB pointer for retry.
policy.accessLogs: Record successful sensitive document downloads without recording signed query strings, signatures, raw object keys or file contents.
policy.testDataCleanup: Test-data reset/deletion must stay TEST-only, use RIDEX_TEST_MODE=true and require exact confirmation; source inspection is not proof of the complete deletion boundary.
policy.otpPurposeDeletionException: The approved RideX exception removes the deleted purpose's configuration history and owned audit rows; unrelated bulk-operation audit rows remain. Existing active OTPs retain their generation-time configuration until normal expiry; tombstones prevent restoration.
policy.expirySemantics: Signed access links expire when expiresAt is less than or equal to the current UTC epoch second.
policy.cleanupJobs: No retention/cleanup job is treated as implemented unless a dedicated durable scheduler/worker and observable deletion evidence are present.

dataClasses.observedBehavior: DELETE creates a tombstone, removes current purpose configuration/history and purpose-owned audit rows; unrelated bulk audit rows are preserved.
OTP expiry and generation-time purpose/configuration snapshots are represented; retention/purge behavior for expired challenge/attempt records is not established by this step.
Authorization grants expire after 120 seconds and are rejected after expiry; bounded opportunistic cleanup runs during issuance, but no durable cleanup schedule is established.
Session expiry/revocation exists; expired/revoked-row cleanup schedule is not established here.
Private object is deleted before its DB pointer; if object deletion fails the DB row remains for retry; signed download is short-lived, audited and no-store.
dataClasses.retentionStatus: DELETE FLOW PRESENT; routine orphan cleanup/retention schedule unresolved

dataClasses.observedBehavior: Document expiry describes validity, not retention; object retention, replacement cleanup and legal hold are not established in this step.

Access is via expiring signed links; successful download validates filename/MIME/content signature, writes an EXPORT audit and uses private no-store/nosniff headers. No approved attachment retention/deletion endpoint or orphan sweep is declared.
Support records and internal notes exist; permanent-delete, legal-hold and retention workflow not established by this step.
Financial models and reconciliation paths exist; do not define a retention duration or a general production delete path without approved accounting/legal rules.
dataClasses.retentionStatus: VERIFY; live deletion prohibited by this contract until approved policy exists

dataClasses.observedBehavior: Audit rows are emitted; OTP-purpose deletion is the documented special exception. General retention, archival and legal-hold behavior are not configured by this step.
Some expired idempotency rows are removed lazily during requests; a global background purge/retention job is not established.
Exhausted/poisoned result records are retained as DEAD_LETTER; manual replay, inspection access control and long-term cleanup schedule unresolved.
Expiry/terminal status fields exist; historical command/result retention and cleanup schedule are not established here.
Backup/restore entrypoints exist; actual backup retention, encryption/key lifecycle and restore verification remain final-phase work.
Version activation/rollback exists; obsolete asset cleanup and retention of previously active versions is not established by this step.
Test-data endpoints require TEST environment, RIDEX_TEST_MODE=true and exact confirmation; prove every cascading target stays within the intended test fixture boundary before use.

finalPhysicalTests: Customer Gallery object-delete failure preserves DB pointer for retry and successful delete removes both object and pointer.
Support attachment signed URL rejects at expiresAt equal to current epoch second.
Support attachment body MIME/signature mismatch is rejected before bytes are served.
Support attachment successful access writes redacted EXPORT audit metadata.
Signed/download responses cannot be cached and include nosniff.
OTP purpose deletion removes only the deleted purpose's rows and preserves unrelated bulk audit records.
Active OTP remains valid only through its recorded generation-time expiry/configuration.
TEST data deletion denies non-TEST runtime and missing/wrong exact confirmation.
Test data purge never deletes live financial/safety records or unrelated IDs.
No general cleanup job deletes financial or audit data before retention/legal approval.
Support attachment retention/deletion and orphan sweep use approved policy and preserve legal holds.
Session/OTP/idempotency cleanup is bounded and does not delete active/in-progress rows.
Dead-letter cleanup preserves unresolved/incident records until authorized retention/replay disposition.
Backups and snapshots obey approved retention and remain restore-verified before purge.
